What is VoicePlug Phone AI, and why do restaurants need it?

VoicePlug's patented Phone AI instantly answers every customer call in under one second, captures accurate orders, and eliminates missed sales. Designed specifically for restaurants, it reduces hold times, prevents abandoned calls, and drives revenue growth.
How does VoicePlug Phone AI work?

VoicePlug's Phone AI technology engages guests naturally, handles custom requests, and intelligently upsells. Every order integrates directly with your POS system, loyalty program, and payment provider, reducing errors and freeing staff for in-store service.

Yes. Our AI ensures no guest waits on hold, every order is accurate, and personalized upsells increase check sizes. Restaurants using VoicePlug report higher satisfaction, repeat visits, and loyalty.

VoicePlug's Drive-Thru AI manages background noise, multiple cars, and interruptions, ensuring fast, accurate orders. It reduces wait times, improves upsells, and boosts operational efficiency at your drive-thru.

Kiosk AI allows guests to place orders independently, customize meals, and apply loyalty rewards. It reduces staff workload, increases average ticket sizes, and integrates seamlessly with your POS and payment systems.

Yes. VoicePlug manages unlimited simultaneous calls, ensuring no orders are missed, even during peak hours or high-volume events.

VoicePlug provides instant staff transfer options, allowing guests to connect with a team member whenever needed, without losing the benefits of automation.

Yes. VoicePlug connects with a record number of restaurant tech integrations, including leading POS systems, loyalty programs, and payment providers, making operations seamless.
